prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet, new drawings based on identity reference. Draw exactly TWENTY full-body animation frames of ONE adult woman, arranged STRICTLY in FOUR equal columns and FIVE equal rows, read left to right then top to bottom. Portrait sheet aspect ratio 2:3, ideally 1024×1536. Each imaginary cell 256×307.2 contains one full body from hair top to complete shoes. Keep generous transparent gutters: hair at 7% cell height, soles at 96%, figure center at 50% cell width. Character occupies 89% cell height. Keep all shoes and hair fully inside own cell. No text, numbers, grid lines, captions, watermarks, panels or ground shadows. Truly transparent RGBA background; do not illustrate a checkerboard. Match the reference's polished pixel-art anime sprite appearance: clean dark pixel outlines, controlled clusters, restrained tiny highlights, no realistic rendering, no extra accessories, no change of costume or age. All TWENTY frames must be newly drawn and distinct. Identity and body size consistent, no chibi shift. The reference is identity/style reference, not a sheet to copy wholesale.

Exact row-major storyboard:
Row 1 cells 1-4 = ambient frames A1 relaxed facing viewer holding usual prop near waist, A2 tiny inhale shoulders lifted 1%, A3 eyes glance down at prop, A4 small practical right-hand gesture interacting with prop.
Row 2 cells 1-4 = ambient A5 continue prop action slightly, A6 gentle blink with prop held stable, A7 exhale and adjust supporting hand, A8 return gaze to viewer, tiny friendly head tilt. The eight ambient frames have almost identical leg stance and body silhouette. Small natural calm motion.
Row 3 cells 1-4 = entrance E1 body at three-quarter angle gently stepping into place while holding prop, E2 front-facing feet settle, E3 free hand starts raising beside shoulder, E4 friendly open-palm wave at shoulder height.
Row 4 cells 1-2 = entrance E5 same wave with wrist tilted other direction and friendly smile, E6 hand lowers into relaxed welcoming gesture.
Row 4 cells 3-4 = turnaround T1 front-facing balanced stance with prop lowered at side, T2 turn torso and face to viewer's right 45 degrees.
Row 5 cells 1-4 = turnaround T3 right-facing 90-degree profile, T4 complete back view 180 degrees, T5 left-facing 90-degree profile, T6 return three-quarter 45 degrees toward viewer from left. Turning includes correct consistent hair, garment back and boots, same body height and natural feet pivot. No magic glow. These six are turning/transformation animation frames, preserve adult build and costume.
Avoid separate decorative icons or particles. Transparent empty surroundings. Draw all20; do not omit final row.
Character identity (every cell): LEAD adult woman: short chestnut-red bob haircut with a wide pale cream streak at her left forehead, green eyes, compact black microphone headset, cropped ivory jacket over teal collared blouse, black belt, charcoal high-waisted loose trousers, dark green and ivory sneakers, black tablet with orange corner accents.
Prop interactions appropriate to this character: look down at tablet; right index taps tablet; lift gaze; soft blink; adjust the tablet grip; relaxed exhale. Preserve the black tablet unless hidden naturally behind body during back-facing turn.
